summary: Phase 1 of the plain-English research console: a /learn/concepts primer with four pages (choice/chance/look-ahead; evaluating a board and the sibling trap; is more computation the answer; what a large-scale run would look like) and a glossary. Concept figures (web/components/Concepts.tsx) show a real position whose two-ply look-ahead tree is computed by the TypeScript engine via web/scripts/generate-concept-scenarios.ts (deterministic search for a stable, reveal-free root where greedy, optimistic, fair and pessimistic chance handling pick different columns); every number in the figures is engine output with a points-only evaluator, labelled as a teaching device. The compute page quotes only retained findings (status.md, finding-12 K-series, finding-13 costs, gpu-01) with technical details in collapsible blocks. Registered theory TH-20260821-search-guided-self-play-at-scale-299ed02f (search-guided self-play with every-sibling labels) as the scale-out research direction, and wrote the drop7-scale-out agent skill (staged pipeline contracts and cluster mappings for a multi-GPU box, SLURM, Kubernetes, Ray, and spot pools), routed from AGENTS.md. No run, seed, or engine was touched; the theory is a proposal with no evidence.
validationPerformed: cd web && npm run concept:scenarios; npx tsc --noEmit; eslint on changed files; npm run build; all /learn routes render 200 under next start; full-page chromium screenshots inspected; make research-validate passes
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
